visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down close-up of a beige cutting board where a pair of hands skillfully slices long green peppers into diagonal segments with a sharp chef's knife. (2) The scene transitions to the hands removing the core from a head of cabbage and cutting the leaves into large, irregular square pieces. Red chili peppers and white scallion segments are also shown being sliced on the same board. (3) The shot shifts to a kitchen stove setting where pork belly slices are blanched in a white pot of boiling water until they turn pale; they are then removed and placed in a mesh strainer to drain. (4) A black cast iron pan is placed on a white portable gas stove and heated with oil; the green peppers are returned to the pan and pressed with a pink spatula until their skin blisters and chars. (5) Aromatics including red chilies and scallions are sautéed in the pan, followed by the blanched pork belly, which is stir-fried until the edges turn golden brown and crispy. (6) A large pile of fresh cabbage leaves is added to the pan and tossed with the pork using a pink spatula and a metal spatula simultaneously. (7) Dark soy-based sauce is poured into the center of the pan, bubbling and releasing steam, before being tossed with the rest of the ingredients. (8) The pre-seared green peppers are added back for a final high-heat toss. (9) The final scene shows a woman with short hair and glasses in a bright indoor living room, wearing an apron, tasting the dish with a bowl of rice and giving a thumbs-up to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 先將糯米椒斜切成段. (2) [Subtitle]: 高麗菜去掉梗. (3) [Subtitle]: 切成塊狀. (4) [Subtitle]: 辣椒切成斜片. (5) [Subtitle]: 蒜苗斜切. (6) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭 剁成蒜末. (7) [Subtitle]: 將五花肉片切成兩等份長度. (8) [Subtitle]: 準備一鍋滾水，水滾之後轉到最小火. (9) [Subtitle]: 放入豬肉片進來汆燙. (10) [Subtitle]: 燙到肉片轉白，就可以取出來放入溫水避免豬肉水蒸發，變乾. (11) [Subtitle]: 放一旁備用. (12) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋開中小火加熱. (13) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡放入一點點的油，潤一下鍋... (14) [Subtitle]: 等鍋熱了，放入糯米椒進來乾煸... (15) [Subtitle]: 可以用鍋鏟壓一壓煎出焦香... (16) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下像這樣煸到表面有一點焦香、虎皮的樣子.. (17) [Subtitle]: 撒上一點胡椒提味. (18) [Subtitle]: 先暫時取出來備用... (19) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡再補一點油放入蒜苗、辣椒進來爆香. (20) [Subtitle]: 翻炒出香味. (21) [Subtitle]: 等到聞到香味，就把五花肉放進來煸炒出焦香. (22) [Subtitle]: 你可以用鍋鏟壓一下，可以更快煎出焦香. (23) [Subtitle]: 大概像這樣微微的焦香就可以了. (24) [Subtitle]: 一點胡椒粉，蒜末提味. (25) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻. (26) [Subtitle]: 聽到肉片滋滋作響的聲音，就可以把高麗菜放進來了. (27) [Subtitle]: 用鍋鏟快速的把肉片跟高麗菜翻炒均勻... (28) [Subtitle]: 可以像像鐵板燒那樣用兩支鏟子一起翻炒，會更省力！ (29) [Subtitle]: 高麗菜先推一邊去，. (30) [Subtitle]: 將所有的醬料嗆入鍋底，激發出醬香（文字食譜請看資訊欄）. (31) [Subtitle]: 快速的翻炒均勻讓肉跟蔬菜都可以均勻的吸收到醬汁... (32) [Subtitle]: 醬汁不要通通燒乾，要保留一些醬汁才會好吃喔！. (33) [Subtitle]: 最後起鍋前，放回糯米椒. (34) [Subtitle]: 快速的跟鍋裡的料翻炒均勻. (35) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，超級簡單又下飯的『糯米椒回鍋肉』就完成啦～❤️❤️❤️.... (36) [Subtitle]: 我超喜歡吃這道『高麗菜回鍋肉』❤️❤️. (37) [Subtitle]: 淡綠色的高麗菜加上煸香的糯米椒. (38) [Subtitle]: 美味的醬汁～真的超級下飯！！❤️. (39) [Subtitle]: 希望大家有時間都可以做看看喔 ❤️. (40) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with the crisp, percussive sound of a sharp knife hitting a cutting board, paired with a bright, energetic female voice narrating in Traditional Chinese. (2) A light, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts and runs continuously throughout the timeline. (3) A clear transition occurs as the sound of splashing water and metallic clinking accompanies the pork blanching phase. (4) A loud, sustained sizzling sound enters the mix as the green peppers hit the hot cast iron pan, signifying the start of active cooking. (5) Frequent metallic scraping sounds of spatulas against the pan are heard as the narrator's tone remains cheerful and instructional. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between cooking steps. (7) When the sauce is poured, a vigorous bubbling and sizzling acoustic texture dominates for several seconds. (8) The audio concludes with a soft crunching sound during the tasting scene, while the narrator encourages viewers to try the recipe, ending on a high melodic note from the background music.
